title: A.P. power infra loss estimated at ₹500-crore; restoration works complete in 4,765 Arnab-hit villages
description: Inspecting the cyclone-hit areas, Gottipati Ravi Kumar says government has intensified emergency repairs to the damaged infrastructure, with special focus on Palakollu, Bhimavaram and Narsapur, which bore the brunt of the extreme weather event
